related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

outcome.analysis_limit: A consumer could see that verification and follow-up records were present and integrity checked but had no direct pointers in the relation to inspect those records. No agent decision or missing investigation was observed.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Improvement relations omit exact evidence references for verified and follow-up observations
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The live bounded compact projection reported verification and subsequent record statuses, and source review showed that relations projected their identities without those records' campaign evidence references.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Include exact evidence references for verified and subsequent records present in the selected page, and preserve improvement links during response compaction.
not_measured: whether agents had difficulty finding verification or follow-up records
recurrence across Environment sessions or versions
time, token, or resource impact of the missing references
whether additional references fit without further compaction under every valid record mix
whether agents use the new pointers to inspect supporting observations
long-term recurrence or effectiveness of this hypothesis
